searches.reason: Develop paired history perturbation probes for the single trained NextItNet model: remove recent coherent interactions, remove older isolated interactions, and shuffle order while preserving left padding and final nonpadding readout. Relate rank changes to the dilated convolution receptive field to identify stale-interest dependence, weak recency sensitivity, and padding or causal leakage bugs. Prioritize practical methods with synthetic controls and uncertainty estimates.
searches.query: NextItNet dilated causal convolution sequential recommendation counterfactual history perturbation recency attribution effective receptive field padding leakage diagnostics 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into auditable failure categories: specific recent-purpose matches, broad similarity, possible duplicates, useful complements, and unsupported compatibility. Seek methods using only public histories, titles, descriptions, timestamps, and explicit feedback; distinguish missing evidence from mismatch and validate annotations on a small manually reviewed sample. These probes should diagnose the existing model without adding a separately fitted scoring system.
searches.query: recommendation diagnostic evaluation user feedback taxonomy intent specificity complement substitute duplicate compatibility uncertainty title description weak supervision annotation validation 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Replace scale-dependent training margins with trustworthy ranking diagnostics. Investigate training-only held-out prefix probes, popularity- and history-length-stratified errors, candidate-set sensitivity, and bootstrap uncertainty. Compare sampled and full-catalog diagnostic rankings without modifying the pinned validation evaluator; require controlled degradations to establish that probes detect known failures before using them to guide training changes.
searches.query: sequential recommender diagnostic metric validation sampled negatives full catalog ranking candidate set bias popularity stratification bootstrap controlled corruption 2024 2025 2026
